links.outcome: Prospective concordance between model predictions and reviewers' decisions on live alerts
links.effect: 92% of vaccine alerts closed in alignment with model's top-ranked prediction; 98% within top 3 predictions; comparable results for drug portfolio.
links.quote: In the prospective validation phase, 92% of vaccine alerts were closed in alignment with the model's top-ranked prediction, while 98% were closed within the top 3 predictions.

unlisted_practices: Using explainable ML (SHAP) to triage pharmacovigilance statistical alerts and reduce reviewer workload
Using ML triage as a quality-control mechanism to detect inconsistencies and human errors in manual triage

screen.reason: Prospective evaluation of an XGBoost machine learning triage tool (MLIT) deployed in real-world pharmacovigilance operations to evaluate decision concordance and time savings.
